name: SEO AI
description: Adds a 'Generate Metatags' button to node edit forms that calls an OpenAI-compatible chat API to suggest title/description/keywords/OG metatags.
project_description:
Optimize your Drupal site's SEO automatically using AI-driven insights and actions.

SEO-AI leverages artificial intelligence to streamline and enhance the SEO capabilities of your Drupal website. Perfect for newcomers and seasoned marketers, this module simplifies complex SEO tasks by providing actionable recommendations and automated features.

 Features 
 Basic Functionality:

 
 Automatically scans your website content for SEO improvements. 
 Provides detailed reports and recommendations to optimize SEO. 
 
 Unique Features:

 
 AI-driven suggestions for content optimization, including keyword analysis and meta tag generation. 
 Real-time SEO scoring to help you understand the impact of your content changes. 
 
 Use Cases:

 
 Ideal for content creators looking to optimize their posts and pages for search engines without deep technical SEO knowledge. 
 Useful for SEO professionals seeking to automate routine tasks and focus on strategic SEO initiatives. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Configuration Process:

 
 Installation: Install the module through the Drupal admin interface or using Drush 
 Configuration: To customize settings, navigate to the SEO-AI configuration page under 'Configuration > Search and Metadata.' 
 Usage: Once configured, the module automatically begins analyzing your site's content. Check the reports section for insights. 
 
 Special Considerations:

 
 Ensure that your content types are properly configured to allow SEO-AI to access and analyze text fields. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Dependencies:

 
 Requires the 'Token' module for dynamic data handling. 
 AI processing may require integration with external AI services (API details needed).
